record: Line of the General Appropriations Act
proves: Congress and the President authorized spending for this purpose, up to this amount, for this year
does_not_prove: That the agency may already commit the amount, that cash exists, that the amount will be spent

record: Allotment: the budget law as allotment order, a SARO or a GARO
proves: DBM authorized the agency to incur obligations up to the amount
does_not_prove: That cash is available for payment. That an obligation exists

record: Release document checked against the blockchain record
proves: DBM issued this document with this content
does_not_prove: That the release was correct, that the agency obligated or paid the amount, that anything was delivered

proves: The servicing bank may pay up to this amount from the sub-account of the agency in this period
does_not_prove: That money was moved to the agency: no cash moves. That a claim is due. That the limit is still open after the quarter

proves: DBM permits a contract for several years with this total cost
does_not_prove: That the amount of any later year is appropriated

record: Line of the Annual Procurement Plan
proves: The head of the procuring entity approved this procurement as planned
does_not_prove: That funds are available. Which budget line pays: the form of 2025 names the source of funds in words. That the procurement was conducted

proves: The procurement or the award was published
does_not_prove: That enough bidders participated. That the award followed the rules

proves: The head of the procuring entity chose this supplier, and both sides are bound
does_not_prove: That an obligation is recorded in the registry. That anything was delivered

record: Purchase order with the line of the chief accountant
proves: The agency ordered these items from this supplier, and the chief accountant stated on the order that funds are available, with the number, date and amount of the obligation request
does_not_prove: That the supplier delivered. That the procurement followed the rules

proves: An amount was charged to an allotment, and the head of the budget unit certified that the allotment was available and obligated. Part C shows later how much became payable and how much was paid
does_not_prove: That goods were delivered, as long as part C shows no payable. That cash exists. Which contract it belongs to: the form has no field for a contract number

proves: The inspection officer or committee states that quantity and specifications are in order, and the property custodian states that the delivery was accepted in full or in part
does_not_prove: That the statements are true. No other body checks them before payment
basis: GAM-V2 App.62, GAM-V1 Ch.8 s.15. COA2011-002 for the absence of pre-audit

record: Disbursement voucher with its five boxes
proves: Officers of the agency signed four statements. The supervisor with direct knowledge: the expense is necessary and lawful. The accounting staff: the accounting entry. The head of the accounting unit: cash is available, the documents are complete and the amount is proper. The head of agency: approved for payment. In the fifth box the payee acknowledges the payment
does_not_prove: That the delivery occurred: this is stated in the acceptance report, by other officers of the same agency. That the payee received the money, as long as the fifth box is empty

proves: The agency ordered the bank to credit the payees listed
does_not_prove: That each payee was credited. An entry is invalidated when the bank branch, the account name or the account number does not agree with the records of the bank

record: Daily report of payment orders issued
proves: The cashier states on oath which payment orders were issued, each with the numbers of the voucher and of the obligation request, the payee and the object code
does_not_prove: That the bank paid. The report also contains approved payment orders that were not yet delivered to the bank

record: List of payment advices validated by the bank
proves: The bank credited the account of the payee. The list is proof of payment when the supplier gives no receipt
does_not_prove: That the payee was the right person, if the data of the agency were wrong

proves: The transaction was entered in the books with these accounts
does_not_prove: That the accounts are the right ones. Appropriations, allotments and obligations are not in the journal at all

record: Registry of allotments, obligations and disbursements
proves: The running balance of one allotment, as the budget unit recorded it
does_not_prove: That it agrees with the books of the accounting unit, which are a second set of records

proves: How much allotment and how much cash authority the agency received, and how much cash authority it used, as the accounting unit recorded it
does_not_prove: That the bank shows the same balance. That needs the monthly bank reconciliation

proves: For one account and one month: the balance in the books and the balance in the bank statement agree after the items listed, for example checks not yet presented and a lapsed NCA
does_not_prove: That each payment was proper. The statement compares cash, and not the claims behind the payments

proves: The agency reported the tax withheld as remitted, and the chief accountant and the head of agency signed. BIR and BTr make their entries from the same document
does_not_prove: That cash moved: none moves. That the tax was computed correctly

proves: The agency certified these amounts of appropriations, allotments, obligations and disbursements for the quarter
does_not_prove: That the amounts are accurate. That deliveries were made
basis: JC2019-1, PEFA2025 (accuracy of reports rated C)

proves: Payments of the month, by kind of cash authority
does_not_prove: That the payments were for accepted deliveries. Advances and transfers are also payments

proves: Obligations that are due and unpaid at the end of the year, by age
does_not_prove: Why they are unpaid

proves: The agency reported these outputs against its plan
does_not_prove: That the outputs exist: the agency reports on itself. That the outputs caused a result

proves: The position and the results as the agency recorded them on the accrual basis
does_not_prove: That they are free of error, until COA has given its opinion

proves: The opinion of the auditor on the statements, and the observations
does_not_prove: That every transaction was examined. That the agency acted on the observations
basis: CONST IX-D.2, PD1445 s.43. Sampling: GK

proves: The auditor rejected a payment and named the persons liable
does_not_prove: That the decision is final: it can be appealed. That the money was returned. The amount enters the books only when the decision is final

record: Notice of Finality and Order of Execution
proves: The decision is final and must be enforced
does_not_prove: That the amount was collected

proves: The collecting officer received this amount
does_not_prove: That the amount was deposited

record: Collection report of a depository bank in NGCDS
proves: The bank received the deposit and reported it to BTr
does_not_prove: To which receipt each amount belongs

proves: The taxpayer declared this tax
does_not_prove: That the tax was paid: payment is a separate act. That the declaration is correct

proves: The officer or the receiving body reported how advanced or transferred money was used
does_not_prove: That the auditor accepted the report
basis: GAM-V2 App.44, GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.63, NBC599 s.3.4

record: Property Acknowledgment Receipt or Inventory Custodian Slip
proves: A named officer accepted responsibility for an item
does_not_prove: That the item still exists. That needs the yearly count
basis: GAM-V2 App.71, App.59, GAM-V1 Ch.10 s.38, COA2022-004

record: Appropriation ordinance of a local government
proves: The sanggunian authorized the local budget
does_not_prove: That the reviewing authority found it valid

record: Corporate Operating Budget approved by the board
proves: The board of the corporation approved its budget
does_not_prove: That DBM will release the subsidy named in it

proves: BLGF computed how much a local government can borrow
does_not_prove: That the project is sound. That the lender or the Monetary Board agreed

record: Clearance of an undertaking in a partnership contract
proves: DOF examined each promise of the national government in the draft contract
does_not_prove: That Congress will appropriate the yearly amounts

record: List of beneficiaries of a cash aid program
proves: The agency found that these persons qualify
does_not_prove: That each person was paid. That proof is in the records of the bank or remittance institution

proves: The agency submitted this figure or status for publication
does_not_prove: That the figure is accurate. The order makes the agency responsible for it, and the documents that I read describe no check by another body
